input.summary: Replace immediate-deletion clause with transition assistance
input.comment: [Playbook] Immediate cessation of assistance and deletion of Customer Data with no export would leave us stranded and contradicts Sections 11.2 and 11.3; we have replaced it with up to six months of transition assistance at then-current rates, with data return and certified deletion following the existing sequence.

ops.oldText: Immediately on termination Vendor shall discontinue all assistance and permanently delete Customer Data without offering an export or migration support.
ops.newText: On expiry or termination for any reason, Vendor shall, at Customer's request, provide reasonable transition assistance, including export and migration support, for up to six months at Vendor's then-current rates, and shall not delete Customer Data except in accordance with Sections 11.2 and 11.3.
